title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
summary: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.
body: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推出全新的API服务层——Ultrafast模式，首批支持基于Cerebras硬件加速的GPT-5.6 Sol模型。该服务层的输出速度可达每秒750个Token，相较标准模式提升高达14倍，专为对延迟极度敏感的高并发实时AI应用场景设计。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI推出基于Cerebras硬件支持的GPT-5.6 Sol“Ultrafast”超快API服务层，推理速度提升高达14倍。
